review.title: First review prompt
review.hint: The instruction a PR review starts with (from the PR Inbox, Dashboard, phone or a PR's Run button). The path to the PR details file is always appended.

rereview.title: Re-review prompt
rereview.hint: Re-review continues the PR’s existing review session: it re-fetches the PR (latest diff, comments and reviews), then sends this prompt.
